required_conditions_i18n.zh-TW: 以 V2 契約條件為準（draft/provisional，未校準）
required_conditions_i18n.en: Judged by the V2 contract conditions (draft/provisional, uncalibrated).
required_conditions_i18n.ja: V2契約の条件に従う（draft/provisional、未校正）。

boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 東勢林場（212公頃森林遊樂區，大安溪畔）園區森林步道的雲霧林與螢火/油桐季景（OSM theme_park 節點；官方海拔資料為 500–700 公尺區間，誠實不取單值）；清單主題的螢火蟲/油桐花季窗查無本站可繫結的權威季節資料源，誠實不建時間窗契約——本契約為森林步道主體。
boosters_i18n.en: Mist-forest trails inside the 212-hectare Dongshi Forest Garden by the Dajia river (OSM theme-park node; official elevation is a 500-700 m range, honestly not collapsed to a single value). The list's firefly/tung-blossom windows have no authoritative seasonal source we can bind, so no time-window contract is built - honestly.
boosters_i18n.ja: 大甲溪畔の東勢林場（212ヘクタール）の霧の森と園内歩道（OSM）。標高は公式資料が500-700mの幅で、単一値にしないため空欄。蛍・油桐の季節窓は権威源がなく誠実に不構築。

penalties_i18n.zh-TW: 惡劣天候、能見度差、營運/季節窗外
penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
